## Description

Please provide a summary of your changes, including the motivation and context. Link any related issues using `Fixes #...` or `Closes #...`.

---

## Type of Change

- [ ] 📚 New System Design Case Study (curriculum content)
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] 🎨 UI/UX or styling improvements
- [ ] 📖 Documentation update
- [ ] 🧪 Tests or verification additions

---

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] I have executed `npm run verify` and all gates passed (typecheck, lint, prettier check, tests, build)
- [ ] If authoring a new case study, it satisfies the 8-section KRUZZ canonical schema
- [ ] Code follows the established project conventions and Prettier formatting
- [ ] Tested locally on `http://localhost:3000`
